mapper.sql: guidance_id, user_id, plan_id, forecast_id, plan_updated_at, input_data_hash, service_stage, action_type, target_amount, current_contribution_amount, recommended_contribution_amount, continue_expected_asset, recommended_expected_asset, investment_principal, market_value, unrealized_profit_loss, return_rate, expected_return_rate, remaining_contribution_count, safety_buffer_amount, reason, market_data_as_of, next_review_at, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO investment_guidance ( user_id, plan_id, forecast_id, plan_updated_at, input_data_hash, service_stage, action_type, target_amount, current_contribution_amount, recommended_contribution_amount, continue_expected_asset, recommended_expected_asset, investment_principal, market_value, unrealized_profit_loss, return_rate, expected_return_rate, remaining_contribution_count, safety_buffer_amount, reason, market_data_as_of, next_review_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{planId}, #{forecastId}, #{planUpdatedAt}, #{inputDataHash}, #{serviceStage}, #{actionType}, #{targetAmount}, #{currentContributionAmount}, #{recommendedContributionAmount}, #{continueExpectedAsset}, #{recommendedExpectedAsset}, #{investmentPrincipal}, #{marketValue}, #{unrealizedProfitLoss}, #{returnRate}, #{expectedReturnRate}, #{remainingContributionCount}, #{safetyBufferAmount}, #{reason}, #{marketDataAsOf}, #{nextReviewAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM investment_guidance guidance WHERE guidance.user_id = #{userId} AND guidance.next_review_at > #{now} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM goal WHERE goal.user_id = guidance.user_id AND goal.status = 'ACTIVE' AND goal.target_amount = guidance.target_amount AND goal.target_amount > 0 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM recurring_investment_plan plan WHERE plan.plan_id = guidance.plan_id AND plan.updated_at = guidance.plan_updated_at ) AND guidance.forecast_id = ( SELECT latest.forecast_id FROM cashflow_forecast latest WHERE latest.user_id = guidance.user_id ORDER BY latest.generated_at DESC, latest.forecast_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AND ( guidance.action_type = 'REVIEW' OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM recurring_investment_plan current_plan INNER JOIN connected_account account ON account.account_id = current_plan.brokerage_account_id WHERE current_plan.plan_id = guidance.plan_id AND account.last_synced_at IS NOT NULL AND ( guidance.market_data_as_of IS NULL OR account.last_synced_at > guidance.market_data_as_of ) ) ) ORDER BY guidance.created_at DESC, guidance.guidance_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM investment_guidance WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND input_data_hash = #{inputDataHash} AND action_type != 'REVIEW' ORDER BY created_at DESC, guidance_id DESC LIMIT 1
